title: If it weren't for, but for, were it not for
summary: Nói nếu không có ai/cái gì thì kết quả đã khác: if it weren't for (hiện tại), if it hadn't been for (quá khứ), but for, were it not for, had it not been for.

dialogue.en: Thanks. [[If it hadn't been for]] my team, I [[wouldn't have won]].
dialogue.vi: Cảm ơn. Nếu không có nhóm mình thì mình đã không thắng.

dialogue.en: Really. [[If it weren't for]] Lan, the project [[would be]] a mess now.
dialogue.vi: Thật mà. Nếu không có Lan thì giờ dự án đã rối tung.

dialogue.en: [[But for]] your ideas, there [[would be]] no project at all!
dialogue.vi: Nếu không có ý tưởng của bạn thì làm gì có dự án!

dialogue.en: [[Were it not for]] luck, we'd still be waiting for funding.
dialogue.vi: Nếu không nhờ may mắn, giờ bọn mình vẫn đang chờ vốn.

sections.heading: If it weren't for + danh từ, would + V
sections.rule: **If it weren't / wasn't for + danh từ** = nếu không có… (hiện tại) → **would + V**.

examples.en: [[If it weren't for]] the map, we [[would be]] lost.
examples.vi: Nếu không có bản đồ, chúng tôi đã lạc.

examples.en: [[If it wasn't for]] her, I'd quit.
examples.vi: Nếu không vì cô ấy, tôi đã nghỉ việc rồi.

check.prompt: If it ___ for my parents, I couldn't afford school.

sections.heading: If it hadn't been for + danh từ, would have + V3
sections.rule: **If it hadn't been for + danh từ** = nếu không có… (quá khứ) → **would have + V3**.

examples.en: [[If it hadn't been for]] the rain, we [[would have won]].
examples.vi: Nếu không vì mưa, chúng tôi đã thắng.

examples.en: [[If it hadn't been for]] the doctor, he [[would have died]].
examples.vi: Nếu không có bác sĩ, ông ấy đã chết.

check.prompt: If it ___ for the traffic, I would have arrived on time.

sections.heading: But for, Were it not for, Had it not been for
sections.rule: **But for + danh từ** dùng cho cả hai thì. Đảo ngữ trang trọng: **Were it not for** (hiện tại), **Had it not been for** (quá khứ).

head: Thường
Trang trọng
rows: If it hadn't been for you, …
Had it not been for you, …

examples.en: [[But for]] your help, I would have failed.
examples.vi: Nếu không có bạn giúp, tôi đã thất bại.

examples.en: [[Had it not been for]] the warning, many would have died.
examples.vi: Nếu không có cảnh báo, nhiều người đã chết.

check.prompt: ___ it not for his support, the company would close.
check.explain: Hiện tại trang trọng: Were it not for.

mistakes.wrong: If it wasn't for the rain, we would have won yesterday.
mistakes.right: If it hadn't been for the rain, we would have won yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: But for you helped me, I would fail.
mistakes.right: But for your help, I would fail.

mistakes.wrong: Had it not for the map, we would have got lost.
mistakes.right: Had it not been for the map, we would have got lost.

mistakes.wrong: If it weren't for you, I will be sad.
mistakes.right: If it weren't for you, I would be sad.

mistakes.wrong: Were not it for her, we would be late.
mistakes.right: Were it not for her, we would be late.
mistakes.why: Trật tự: Were it not for.
